raw.query: WITH sim AS (SELECT d.run_id, CASE WHEN d.run_id = 'live:twin_fc_p90_cap4' THEN 'forecast' ELSE 'reactive' END AS policy, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS chunk_p99_ms, BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) AS any_sla_violation, MAX(c.provisioned_worker_seconds) AS replica_seconds FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost c USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90_cap4', 'live:twin_re_cap4') GROUP BY d.run_id), live AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.v_live_anchor) SELECT s.policy, s.run_id AS simulation_run, s.ttft_p99_ms AS sim_ttft_p99_ms, l.ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99_ms, s.chunk_p99_ms AS sim_chunk_p99_ms, l.chunk_latency_p99_ms AS live_chunk_p99_ms, s.any_sla_violation AS sim_fails_sla, (l.ttft_p99_ms > 1000 OR l.chunk_latency_p99_ms > 100) AS live_fails_sla, ROUND((100 * ABS(l.ttft_p99_ms - s.ttft_p99_ms) / s.ttft_p99_ms)::numeric, 3) AS ttft_p99_diff_pct_of_sim, ROUND((100 * ABS(l.chunk_latency_p99_ms - s.chunk_p99_ms) / s.chunk_p99_ms)::numeric, 3) AS chunk_p99_diff_pct_of_sim, s.replica_seconds AS sim_replica_seconds, l.replica_seconds AS live_replica_seconds, ROUND((100 * ABS(l.replica_seconds - s.replica_seconds) / s.replica_seconds)::numeric, 3) AS replica_time_diff_pct_of_sim FROM sim s JOIN live l USING (policy) ORDER BY s.policy
raw.observed: Forecast passes in simulation and live; reactive fails in both. Reactive TTFT p99 differs by 1.051% and chunk p99 by 0.953% from simulation. Replica-time differs by 5.264% for forecast and 7.641% for reactive.
raw.claimed: Forecast passes live as simulated; reactive fails live, its p99 within 1.1% of simulation; provisioned replica-time agrees within 8%.
raw.evidence: Both verdict directions match, both reactive p99 measures are within 1.1%, and both policy replica-time differences are below 8% using simulation as denominator.
